title: Flow Engine Primitives
description: Catalog of flow primitives that the AI can compose into business process automations.

primitives.name: condition
primitives.description: Evaluate an expression and branch to different steps

then.description: Step IDs to execute if true

else.description: Step IDs to execute if false

primitives.name: delay
primitives.description: Wait for a specified duration before continuing

primitives.name: approval
primitives.description: Require a user with a specific role to approve or reject

role.description: Role that must approve (e.g. dg, manager)

on_approved.description: Step IDs to execute on approval

on_rejected.description: Step IDs to execute on rejection

primitives.name: notify
primitives.description: Send a notification via one or more channels

primitives.name: loop
primitives.description: Repeat a set of steps over a collection

as.description: Variable name for the current item

steps.description: Step IDs to execute for each item

primitives.name: assign
primitives.description: Assign a value to a data path

on_error.description: Step IDs on HTTP error or timeout

primitives.name: end
primitives.description: Terminal step — marks the end of a flow branch
